Come Build Your Career at Aecon!
Aecon delivers some of the most complex and impactful infrastructure projects — from transformative transportation networks to critical energy, industrial and nuclear programs. The projects we build connect communities and power future generations. With deep roots in North America and a strong footprint internationally, Aecon brings global expertise and proudly serves public and private sector clients through its Construction and Concessions segment.
Safety Always is not only our #1 core value – it is the standard that anchors our culture. We believe the most ambitious projects deserve the most committed people. At Aecon, you won’t just build your career — you’ll help build what matters to enable future generations to thrive.
At Aecon, You Can Count On
Safety Always. Our number one core value. The safety of our people, projects, partners, and stakeholders is our priority focus – today and always.
Integrity. We lead by example, with humility and courage.
Accountability. We’re passionate about delivering on our commitments.
Inclusion. We provide opportunities where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute fully.
We deliver infrastructure with purpose, and our people are at the heart of everything we do. Aecon employees are incredibly proud to build some of the most impactful infrastructure of this generation – we call it Aecon Proud .
At Aecon We
Ensure you and your family receive the services and benefits needed to support your mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
Are intentional when it comes to investing in your development. We help you build your career and advance your skills through our Aecon University, tuition reimbursement, and Leadership Programs.
Are committed to creating work environments focused on mutual respect, teamwork, collaboration, and new ideas, through meaningful initiatives, training, partnerships with Veteran groups, our Aecon Women in Trades and diversity programs, as well as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), to ensure we are building with top talent and harnessing our collective strengths within every aspect of our culture.
Operate responsibly by managing risk, safety, and environmental considerations across all our projects and surrounding communities.
Our success is built on the passion, expertise, and dedication of our people. Together, we embrace strong execution, innovation, and continuous improvement — values that come to life through the unique talents and collaborative spirit of every team member. If you’re inspired to make a difference through future-building projects, join our best-in-class team.
What is the Opportunity?
Aecon’s Civil East sector is a cornerstone of our construction and infrastructure operations, delivering innovative solutions to some of the most complex and impactful projects globally. Renowned for its expertise in heavy civil construction, our Civil East sector specializes in building essential infrastructure that powers economies and enhances communities.
In the Caribbean region, we are leveraging our expertise and collaborative approach to deliver world-class infrastructure projects tailored to meet the unique needs of the island communities.
We are seeking a dedicated and proactive Storekeeper. Reporting to the Plant Supervisor, the Storekeeper is responsible for the receiving, storing, tracking, and distribution of tools and equipment to ensure they are properly maintained and readily available. This role will be based in Barbados and is a site position where the Storekeeper will be working mainly in an outdoor environment.

Receive, inspect, and accurately record the quantity, location, and type of tools and parts.
Process requisitions and distribute tools and equipment to internal users, maintaining accurate records of who has what.
Inspect and ensure tools are properly maintained.
Conduct regular stock checks and reconcile any discrepancies to maintain accurate inventory levels.
Adhere to safety protocols and regulations related to tool handling and storage.
Maintain accurate records of all inventory transactions, including deliveries, returns, and adjustments.

Power im Lager gesucht ? Pack jetzt mit an!
Du bist körperlich fit, suchst eine Herausforderung, die dich fordert, und arbeitest gerne präzise? Wir suchen ab sofort engagierte Lageristen (m/w/d) auf temporärer Basis für einen Einsatz am Flughafen.
**Deine Aufgaben im Einsatz:**
* Qualitätskontrolle: Du prüfst eingehende Lieferungen auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit.
* Lagerlogistik: Du sorgst für die fachgerechte Einlagerung und behältst den Überblick bei der Bestandspflege.
* Kommissionierung: Du stellst Warenbestellungen präzise zusammen und rüstest diese für den Versand.
* Allrounder-Mentalität: Du packst dort an, wo Unterstützung benötigt wird.
Qualifikationen

* Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits im Lager gearbeitet. Eine Ausbildung als Logistiker EFZ ist ein grosses Plus.
* Staplerausweis: Ein SUVA-anerkannter Ausweis ist vorteilhaft und gern gesehen.
* Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst fliessend in Deutsch (Wort und Schrift). Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
* Körperliche Verfassung: Du bist belastbar und hast keine Scheu vor anpackender Arbeit.

* Einwandfreier Leumund: Ein sauberer Strafregisterauszug ist zwingend erforderlich.
* Wohnsitz: Falls du noch keine 5 Jahre in der Schweiz lebst, benötigen wir zusätzlich einen aktuellen Strafregisterauszug aus deinem Herkunftsland.
Bist du bereit für den Einsatz?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Préparation des commandes du soir dans la plateforme logistique d’un distributeur B2B à Renens, en CDI à 100 %, horaire jusqu’à 22 h, entrée à convenir.

Notre client est une entreprise de distribution bien établie en Suisse romande, qui approvisionne chaque jour des professionnels : artisans, entreprises et industrie. Sa plateforme logistique de l’Ouest lausannois reçoit les commandes de la journée et les expédie le soir même pour une livraison le lendemain matin.

Vous faites partie de l’équipe du soir : vous préparez et emballez les commandes passées dans la journée pour qu’elles partent en tournée le soir même et arrivent chez les clients le lendemain matin, sous la responsabilité du responsable du dépôt.

· Préparer les commandes clients au scanner, à l’unité et au colis, selon l’ordre des tournées.
· Préparer certaines marchandises à la mesure (découpe, conditionnement).
· Emballer, étiqueter et mettre les colis à disposition des chauffeurs et des transporteurs.
· Réapprovisionner les zones de préparation et signaler les ruptures.
· Ranger les arrivages de fin de journée aux emplacements prévus.
· Participer aux inventaires tournants.
· Maintenir le dépôt propre et rangé, trier les emballages et les déchets.

· Horaire de l’après-midi et du soir : prise de service en début d’après-midi, fin de service vers 22 h, du lundi au vendredi.
· Entrée en fonction à convenir.
· Poste fixe à 100 %, présence sur site à Renens.
· Dépôt accessible en voiture et en transports publics, parking sur place.
· Chaussures de sécurité fournies.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.
Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.
Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.
Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.
Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Adaptability in fast-paced environments , with the ability to remain focused under pressure.
Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.
Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.
A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.
A customer-first mindset , understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.
Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.
